description: A red plate sits on the bed in front, with several small toys nearby including a tiny white cup, a yellow duck, a green block, and a pink frosted donut. The right hand moves in from the right toward the cluster of toys, pinches and lifts the small cup as a right-hand object, carries it leftward over the red plate, then lowers and releases it so the cup rests on the plate while the hand withdraws upward.
